methodological_eligibility.evidence_quote: The main focus of this paper is to provide a strategic review of the respondent’s energy management systems with regard to the levels of maturity of their EnMS, the key decision making priorities of management (and how they effect the energy strategy), as well as the barriers and potential opportunities, relevant to the further development of their EnMS.

stage1.ineligibility_reason: EnMS maturity/barrier review without an identifiable or characterised EnPI/EnB measurement model in the extracted text.

paper_type.evidence_quote: The level of maturity of each EnMS was assessed, scored and compared.

stage1.notes: Pages 5-6 label an energy model but provide no extractable variables, functional form, or construction approach; EnPI references elsewhere are requirements or gaps.
